_comment: An INDEPENDENT acceptance contract — the claims a reviewer/issue sets BEFORE the work, separate from receipt-input.json (which the agent writes). Run: receipts qa --input examples/receipt-input.json --contract examples/acceptance-contract.json --no-judge  — and watch the report tag each claim 'contract' (independent) instead of 'self-graded'.

acceptanceCriteria.claim: The page heading 'Receipts Demo' is visible
On first load with no tasks, an empty state with the text 'No tasks yet' is visible
acceptanceCriteria.navigationHint: open the app root as a fresh visitor

acceptanceCriteria.claim: After adding a task, it appears as an item in the list and the empty state is gone
acceptanceCriteria.navigationHint: type a task into the input and click Add
